summary: Clearmind Medicine Inc. filed a Form 6-K on April 20, 2026, announcing an agreement to issue and sell convertible promissory notes with an aggregate principal amount of $2,700,000 to existing CLA Investors, at a 90% purchase price ($2,430,000 cash). This is a routine financing transaction under previously disclosed securities purchase agreements, not a special situation. The closing is expected on April 21, 2026, and the notes are convertible, but there is no acquisition, divestiture, activism, or other special event. The filing is incorporated by reference into prior registration statements.
